## Overview

This directory contains Root Cause Analyses related to business process failures, workflow bottlenecks, and process automation issues that impact business operations.
page_texts.3:
[rcas/business/README.md#examples-of-business-process-rcas]

## Examples of Business Process RCAs

- Workflow bottlenecks causing SLA breaches
- Manual process errors leading to system inconsistencies
- Business rule conflicts across systems
- Process automation failures
- Change management process breakdowns
- Approval workflow failures
- Document routing and approval delays
- Business continuity plan failures
- Cross-functional process coordination issues
